# Food image sources

The food preset SVGs in this folder come from [Google Noto Emoji](https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji), pinned to commit `8998f5dd683424a73e2314a8c1f1e359c19e8742`.

- Source path: `svg/emoji_u*.svg`
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Local license copy: `LICENSE-NOTO-EMOJI.txt`

The SVG files are used without modification.
